title: Ethiopian Water Chestnut Doro Wot
description: A pescatarian-friendly Ethiopian dish featuring water chestnut, with a nutty and crisp texture, wrapped in leaves and steamed to perfection, served in a spicy Doro Wot sauce.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onions, garlic, and ginger and saute until the onions are translucent.
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the water chestnuts, fish sauce, and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the water chestnuts are tender.
While the water chestnut mixture is cooking, prepare the collard green leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
Wrap the water chestnut mixture in the collard green leaves, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Steam the wrapped water chestnut mixture over boiling water for 10 minutes, or until the leaves are tender.
Serve the Doro Wot hot, garnished with chopped nuts.
